capabilities: Open .plist and .mobileconfig files in a dedicated read-only view
Parse XML plist values into typed tree nodes with key paths and search
Show line-numbered source view with lightweight XML highlighting
Summarize configuration profile metadata and payloads with security warnings
Show explicit fallback states for binary, invalid, and large files
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Binary plists are detection-only in v0.1 (reported as unsupported), and the plugin is strictly inspect-only: it never installs, activates, or applies profiles and never writes files back.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to inspect Apple property list or configuration profile files stored in a vault, so they are unreadable without external tools.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens Apple .plist and .mobileconfig files as typed trees, line-numbered source, and configuration profile security summaries.
